page.overview:
Who is Truth-Hearing?

Truth-Hearing sits under the desk of the Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha and knows the truth of everything. When Sun Wukong and an impersonator travelled to the Underworld, Truth-Hearing knew which one was real, but refused to reveal it as the fake was still powerful enough to destroy the Underworld.

By placing its belly to the ground, Truth-Hearing can instantly know the true and false of all things across Heaven, the Underworld, and the Four Continents.
